mark.role: Le protagoniste. Il arrive de Montreal pour s'installer a Berlin, et chaque episode est une demarche du quotidien qu'il doit franchir en allemand.
mark._voix: Voix masculine allemande, pas encore choisie. audio/candidats_mark.json porte les candidates ; audio/comparatif_voix.py --personnage mark fabrique le comparatif a l'aveugle.
mark.apparence: A photorealistic twenty-five-year-old man of Central European appearance, shown from the chest up against a plain light background, facing the camera in soft, even frontal light. FACE: oval with full cheeks, a soft jawline tapering to a gently rounded chin, and a broad forehead. Fair skin with a warm pink undertone and a faint stubble shadow along the jaw and upper lip. HAIR: dark brown, thick and naturally wavy, with real volume on top and shorter at the sides; brushed up and back, slightly unruly rather than styled, a loose curl falling toward the forehead. EYES: warm brown, almond-shaped, medium-set and fairly wide apart, with a visible eyelid crease and slight hooding; a direct, friendly gaze. EYEBROWS: dark brown, fairly straight with a gentle arch, medium thickness. NOSE: straight bridge of medium width with a softly rounded, defined tip. MOUTH: medium-full lips with a defined cupid's bow, held in a closed-lip smile that lifts slightly more on one side and creases the cheek. BUILD: athletic and solidly made — thick neck, broad shoulders, the frame of an endurance athlete rather than a slim model. Young, healthy and approachable, with a slightly boyish openness. Natural skin texture, no retouching, no studio glamour.

Trois autres sont ecrits plus larges qu'il ne faudrait -- cheveux plus

garde_robe.voyage: Dark technical shell jacket over a plain dark t-shirt, dark jeans. Travel clothes, slightly rumpled.
garde_robe.administration: Light blue button-down shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm, navy trousers, brown leather belt. Making an effort without dressing up.
garde_robe.quotidien: Plain knit sweater over a t-shirt, dark trousers. Nothing to notice.
garde_robe.travail: Button-down shirt under an unstructured dark jacket, no tie.
garde_robe.sport: Running kit. Reserved for an episode that calls for it -- a club, a race, a physiotherapist.
garde_robe.formel: Navy suit, white shirt, patterned blue tie. For a job interview or a first day at the office.

mark.apparence_distanciee: A man of twenty-five, of Central European appearance. Dark brown hair, thick and slightly wavy, worn short at the sides with natural volume on top. Fair skin with a warm undertone; dark, well-defined eyebrows; brown eyes. A full face with a broad, softly squared jaw and rounded cheeks. Athletic, solidly built — broad shoulders and a sturdy frame, the build of an endurance athlete rather than a slim model. Clean-shaven. An open, easy smile that reaches the eyes. Understated, well-fitted clothing with no visible branding. Approachable and unpolished — a real person, not a corporate presenter.
mark.apparence_courte: A photorealistic twenty-five-year-old man of Central European appearance, facing camera in soft frontal light against a plain background. Oval face, full cheeks, soft jaw, gently rounded chin. Thick dark brown wavy hair with volume on top, shorter at the sides, slightly unruly. Warm brown almond eyes, straight dark eyebrows. Straight nose with a softly rounded tip. Closed-lip smile lifting more on one side. Fair skin, warm undertone, faint stubble. Athletic build, broad shoulders, thick neck. Natural skin texture, no retouching.

anna.role: Celle qui renseigne. Employee, guichetiere, voisine serviable -- elle change de metier d'un episode a l'autre, mais c'est toujours elle qui sait et qui explique clairement.
anna._voix: Aurora, la voix du cours depuis la v407, choisie a l'aveugle par Barbara le 3 septembre 2026. Les apprenants l'entendent depuis des mois : c'est la voix qu'ils reconnaissent, et c'est pour cela qu'elle joue celle qui explique.
anna.apparence: A woman of about thirty, of Northern European appearance. Straight dark blonde hair to the shoulders, often tied back. Light eyes, fair skin, minimal makeup. An even, attentive face — the expression of someone used to being asked questions and answering them patiently. Average build, upright posture. Practical, plain clothing.

garde_robe.service: Plain uniform-style shirt in a solid colour, a lanyard or a name badge. Whatever counter she is behind.
garde_robe.administration: Neutral blouse, cardigan. Office, not corporate.

erzaehler.role: La voix hors champ des plans de decor. Elle pose le lieu, l'heure et ce que Mark vient y faire, puis se tait des que le dialogue commence.
_voix: Aurora, comme Anna. Elles partagent donc une voix.
Cela tient parce que la narratrice se tait des qu'Anna parle, et qu'un
plan de decor n'est jamais colle a une replique d'Anna. Si un episode
les fait alterner, il faudra une troisieme voix -- c'est la seule
